items.title: Dealer positive-gamma THINS BACK while front IV keeps EASING and the pin band NARROWS with spot RETREATING toward the flip, all on a FROZEN completed-bar frontier (2026-08-04 unchanged) into an even-calmer VIX band and a down-auction tape: from the prior morning 2026-08-05 read to this pre-close 2026-08-05 re-read on the SAME completed 2026-08-04 daily bar, SPY signed net GEX falls (+4.574B → +2.687B, ~-41%, sign stays positive), the call wall eases 780 → 775 while the put wall holds at 770 (the pin band NARROWS from 10-wide back to 5-wide) as spot slips 776.18 → 771.96 and drops back BELOW the prior 780 call wall toward the 768.16 flip, and the front expected move NARROWS further with atmIV CHEAPENING (±7.05 → ±4.79, 24.55% → 16.76%) — while the completed-bar frontier stays at 2026-08-04, the VIX band eases further (16.9 → 15.7, score 0), breadth holds broad (62.16%), SPY holds the 52-week high, but the intraday tape turns to a Trend day · down auction (spot 771.96 below VWAP 773.46).
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior 'gamma-thickens-with-IV-easing-and-band-widening' axis on a frozen frontier: that axis paired MORE positive gamma with a WIDENING pin band and spot breaking UP through the prior call wall (front vol easing). THIS axis is the mirror image on the SAME frozen 2026-08-04 frontier — positive gamma THINS back, the pin band NARROWS, spot RETREATS back below the prior call wall toward the flip, front vol eases further, and the intraday auction rotates to a down-trend day. It is also distinct from a plain gamma-thinning axis (which says nothing about the band, spot path, or front vol) and from a frontier-advance persistence axis (no new completed bar exists here). Emit only when the completed-bar frontier is UNCHANGED (no advance) AND signed net GEX FALLS materially with the sign held positive AND the pin band NARROWS (call wall down, put wall flat-or-up) with spot RETREATING back below the prior call wall toward the flip AND atmIV / front expected move EASE — so a re-read that thickens gamma, widens the band, breaks spot up, or advances the frontier does not trip this flag.
items.method: Add a 'gamma-thins-with-IV-easing-and-band-narrowing-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares the prior-window options/gamma read to the current read while asserting the completed-bar frontier is UNCHANGED (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate holds 2026-08-04 with freshSymbolCount==symbolCount==291, carriedSymbolCount==0, missingSymbolCount==0, and the swing bar count static at 508). Assert FIVE joint conditions: (1) FROZEN FRONTIER — expectedSessionDate unchanged versus the prior window and swing bars static (508 → 508); (2) GAMMA THINS — signedNetGEX falls materially (4.574B → 2.687B, ~-41%) with the sign staying positive; (3) PIN BAND NARROWS AND SPOT RETREATS — the call wall eases (780 → 775) while the put wall is flat-or-up (770 → 770) so the band narrows 10-wide → 5-wide, and spot falls (776.18 → 771.96) to drop back BELOW the prior call wall (780) toward the flip (768.16); (4) FRONT VOL EASES — atmIV falls (24.55% → 16.76%) and the front expected move narrows (±7.05 → ±4.79); (5) CALM-IMPLIED / TAPE-ROTATION GUARD — the VIX band eases further (16.9 → 15.7, score 0), breadth holds broad (62.16%, threshold 60) and SPY holds the 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0, bull-stack) while the intraday auction rotates to a Trend day · down (spot 771.96 below VWAP 773.46). Emit only when (1) AND (2) AND (3) AND (4) AND (5) all hold; the divergence is (2)+(3) thinning/downward-narrowing gamma with a spot retreat occurring together with (4) EASING front vol and a (5) down-auction tape — the reverse of the prior thickening/upward-widening pairing.
